summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) for an SEC-registered offering of $3.5 billion in unsecured notes across three tranches: $1.0B 4.800% notes due 2031, $1.0B 5.350% notes due 2036, and $1.5B 6.100% notes due 2056. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, ranked equally with other unsubordinated debt. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The offering is a standard debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Application will be made to list on Nasdaq Global Market within 30 days.
